Close the PR under the "help wanted" rule: `gh pr close 40048 --repo zulip/zulip`

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the work here, but we're closing this PR because issue #20229 isn't labeled "help wanted", and contributors can only work on issues with that label. Please see the guide on [picking up issues](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/contributing.html) for how to find ones that are open for contributions.
```
